cooper.title: Become a COOPER’S — join the cooperative team

cooper.role_p: The COOPER’S is an active member of the O’SCOP cooperative team, taking part in the hub’s operations close to the field:
cooper.li1: Process the purchase needs assigned by the hub
cooper.li2: Qualify suppliers and follow up pending memberships
cooper.li3: Coordinate LOGI’SCOP carriers in their territory
cooper.li4: Animate the community of buyers and sellers in their country
cooper.after_note: After reviewing your application, the hub opens your COOPER’S space and helps you get started.
